text_block_list.text:
Having drawn courage from Sweep Tosho, 
Zenno Rob Roy claimed victory in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) and declared her intent to 
conquer the upcoming Japan Cup next.

Meanwhile, Sweep Tosho tries to make her 
Trainer decide which race she should 
compete in against the Triple Crown 
contenders.

What to do about the crucial stage that 
would cast the magic of racing upon the 
world? That decision rested entirely upon 
her performance in today's Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup.
